statement: For a Puck slot interface, hid-steam first queries wireless connection status at probe and treats report 0x79 with a two-byte size check as connect or disconnect according to its event byte. Missing gamepad or battery registration can also cause a subsequent accepted IBEX input or battery report to schedule connection. The work queue observes the latest connected state.

applicability.revision: pinned Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0 consumer source; retail hardware unmeasured
applicability.scope: Steam Controller 2026 Puck receiver consumer behavior; no physical or virtual host test
